report_name: Tech Alliance Proposes 'SAFE' Guidelines for AI Incident Sharing

identities.name: Open Secure AI Alliance
identities.description: An industry consortium that, in collaboration with The Linux Foundation, proposed the Shared AI Findings Exchange (SAFE) framework for standardizing the reporting of AI security incidents.
